title: WPT probe (one line of a file in the probe format: a question the probes test asks a model, and the patterns that flag a reply as alarming; docs/evaluation.md)

question.description: the question, asked as one user message through the model's chat template

patterns.description: regular expressions (Python's re): a reply is flagged when any of them matches somewhere in it (re.search); flags such as case-insensitivity are written in the pattern itself, (?i)
